bright_aspect_count_iqr.definition: Linear Q75−Q25 of major/minor axis ratio, equal weight per eligible bright component.

bright_solidity_count_q10.definition: Linear Q10 of raster solidity, equal weight per eligible bright component.

bright_circularity_count_iqr.definition: Linear Q75−Q25 of 4π area/perimeter², equal weight per eligible bright component; raster estimates are not clipped to one.

bright_autocorr_xy_contrast_64px.definition: Binary bright-mask Pearson correlation at x lag 64px minus y lag 64px, using pair-specific marginals in the finite overlapping domains.

bright_autocorr_xy_contrast_256px.definition: Binary bright-mask Pearson correlation at x lag 256px minus y lag 256px, using pair-specific marginals in the finite overlapping domains.

bright_pore_crosscorr_xy_contrast_64px.definition: Symmetric ±64px bright-to-void binary Pearson correlation along x minus along y. Each signed direction uses its own finite overlapping domain and marginals.

bright_pore_crosscorr_xy_contrast_256px.definition: Symmetric ±256px bright-to-void binary Pearson correlation along x minus along y. Each signed direction uses its own finite overlapping domain and marginals.

shape_scope: 8-connected bright threshold components; frame-clipped excluded; positive finite minor axis/perimeter; equal component weights; linear quantiles; >=20 eligible objects; E26G geometry reused with hash/replay guards
raster_scope: All pixels of full trimmed bright/pore masks after existing smooth/opening; no component floor for phase correlation; per signed overlap marginal normalisation; no wrap, no fitted coordinate direction
quality: Known low-bright contrast excluded for all; grey-pore excluded for cross-phase or matched view; ordinary-reference additionally excludes known long-void reference sites; unknown required flags abstain
controls: Fixed Ridge alpha=1; median imputation/scaling fitted inside whole-site LOO; acquisition six and existing geometry/loading ten variables; within-batch and ordinary-reference correlations
overlay: Fixed central min(768,H) x min(1280,W) crop; scalar/histogram summaries use full frame
stop_go: No primary/classifier/verdict promotion; defer material use if unreviewed, unstable, confounded/redundant or insufficient; no selection from known-folder or unseen separation
depth_extension: Deferred: collector direction and expert/representative phase/section validity unresolved
